title: The Secrets of Monkey Island - An Evening With Ron Gilbert
summary: A very long livestream in which Ron Gilbert and Frank Cifaldi look at the making of The Secret of Monkey Island, including its SCUMM source code, which they edit and recompile live.
why: Pointed to as a rare look at the real SCUMM code of a classic adventure game.

quote.text: There is a (crazy long) Youtube video [1] where they take a peek at the SCUMM code for the first Monkey Island, and hack it almost on the fly.
